scope: Official-source recovery audit for Surrey County Council by-elections previously lacking candidate-result evidence. This file records retrieval status only; it does not supply missing candidate values.

records.evidence_text: The official Council minutes confirm Ramon Gray was elected for Weybridge following the 7 May 2015 by-election.
records.notes: Winner-only confirmation is not treated as a complete candidate-level result page. No candidate rows were created.

records.source_type: Epsom & Ewell Borough Council declaration of result
records.evidence_text: The official declaration publishes all six candidates, party descriptions, votes, the elected candidate, one vacant seat, electorate, ballot papers issued, rejected ballots and turnout.
records.notes: Vote shares and total votes were not calculated from the declaration; their fields remain null.

records.evidence_text: The official Council minutes confirm Wyatt Ramsdale was elected for Farnham South following the 18 August 2016 by-election.
records.notes: Winner-only confirmation is not treated as a complete candidate-level result page. No candidate rows were created.

records.evidence_text: The official archive lists a Haslemere by-election dated 7 July 2026, but this audit did not locate a verified official candidate-result page or declaration.
records.notes: No candidate rows were created. The archive listing is retained as event-level provenance only.
